chunk_map.heading: Your customers hire the product to make progress

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L6 "Knowing the commute changed what the shake was up against." Closest: "the commute" and "the shake" both named earlier in L6 (milkshakes, long boring commute); "those buyers" resolves to "40% of milkshakes were bought" in the same sentence pair. Harm (unresolvable pointer) absent.
L6 "A well-known case is older, from a 2005 article." Closest: points at an external article by date, not at another deck file by position; harm (callback to a file whose position varies) absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8: no "the X you did/saw/caught" phrasing; grep for "you (did|saw|caught)" in body returns 0 matches.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-8: slide carries a definition, a worked case and a takeaway; closest to thin is L8 "A feature list answers the wrong question. Name your customer's circumstance and the progress they are after." but it sits under three claim-bearing paragraphs, so the chunk self-carries.

L1 "Your customers hire the product to make progress" vs L4 "Customers hire a product to help with that job" and L8 "the progress they are after": header is a true summary of the content; no bold leads to contradict it.

L6 "Improving the shake for a customer profile had not lifted sales. Knowing the commute changed what the shake was up against." Closest to a cadence tic (two short declaratives), but no Not-X-Not-Y, no anaphora triple, no superlative, no number-plus-retraction, no verb triplet; L6 "40%" is carried with its label. Greps: "Not .* Not" 0, "most useful|best|powerful" 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -nE '\b(below|above|surface|firing|compendium|beat|mood)\b' over body L1-9 -> 0 hits (exit 1); closest vocabulary is "job to be done" (L4), the quoted Christensen coinage, not repo dialect.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' over body L1-9 -> 0 bold elements; budget is <=1.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: slide file; presence in the composed deck is owed by the including module, not this unit

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/slides/the-job-they-hire-it-for.md -> "OK — 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent." exit 0; no Phase/Step refs in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/the-job-they-hire-it-for.md -> "OK — 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut." exit 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no in-body links; derive-body-view signals has_urls false

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file curriculum/slides/the-job-they-hire-it-for.md -> "slides: 1 ... oversized: 0 ... within limits" exit 0; one chunk, 3 paragraphs, 0 bullets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 "Your customers hire the product to make progress" is a declarative claim, the lecture-heading shape; no imperative/label mismatch.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L8 "A feature list answers the wrong question. Name your customer's circumstance and the progress they are after." Closest to class (c) kicker, but it adds a move (name the circumstance) and a new object (feature list) the header and earlier paragraphs do not state, so it earns its slot.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 header vs L4-8 body: body answers the header (customers hire for progress; the case shows circumstance); no inherited bullets answering a different old header. Maintainer STATUS L12 records a fresh build, not a rename.
